risk_note: RV1 by path (agent orchestrator, stream/mount, http), treated as high risk: order ownership. Scenario entry (A6, BR-AI-01 细则「情境入口」): a message with context is input-checked first; context.product_key quotes through the link path's deterministic quote, records the card in the session result set (a later get_rebate_quote on the same product, by card_id or ref_ordinal, returns the entry card's id, no second card), then hands the words to the model; without a model it ends at the card. Upstream business results (delisted, price_unavailable) end stop with the link path's notice and count; a server-side failure ends error 50401 when no model output follows (also when the models degrade after the quote_failed notice). 退还 1 条配额由后续单 B3-05r（D10-1411）覆盖——this task does not touch stream/run. context.order_id: identity first (guest login, unbound bind_phone, no order read), then the tool that would be called (explain_order) off → OrderList guide, or agent.guide.unavailable when the page guide is off or the input source is not allowed; own order → 1 order_status card + T5, run ends; not in scope answers exactly like 0 orders (order_list.empty + handoff). Only explain_order off with list_my_orders on still gives OrderList: ruled by D10-1467 per 规划 009592348c33 08_AI line 131 (BR-AI-01「订单工具只关一部分」; SPEC_REF bump in #13). context.text is dropped in http and runAgent.
